text:
emma: Heads-up — pre-commit SAST is failing on keystore client code in PR #4821. Error looks like KMS decrypt permission denied after yesterday's RBAC change. Anyone from sec/infra available?

jay: On it. Can you paste the CI failure snippet and the service account used by the job?

emma: Paste from the runner logs:

```
2026-03-23T14:02:11Z ERROR keystore: decrypt failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = Permission 'cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt' denied for serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
stack: keystore/kms.go:83 -> keystore/client.go:42
```

CI job env: `SERVICE_ACCOUNT=ci-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`, job: `ci/sast/pre-commit`

maria: That permission was removed in the RBAC tidy yesterday (rollup of least-privilege PRs). Looks like the keystore client still needs it for test fixtures. Can you confirm whether the job should use an ephemeral test SA instead?

jay: Short-term fix: add a scoped binding back for `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` on the specific key for `ci-runner` until we refactor tests. Long-term: switch CI to use `ci-test-sa` with limited scope + grant via ephemeral token.

devsecops-bot: Audit event found: `principal: terraform@infra-prod` modified IAM binding on `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/app_key` at 2026-03-22T21:43:01Z — removed member `serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` from role `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`. (link: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/activity)

oncall-jordan: I can re-add the binding for the key for the `ci-runner` principal for 1 hour, then we make a follow-up ticket to migrate CI. Want me to do that now?

emma: Please yes — tests are blocked and the PR touches payment client path. If you can scope to the key and expiry, that's ideal.

maria: Also please capture the audit event ID and attach to the SNYK ticket. We need the evidence chain for the change. I'll open a quick remediation ticket and tag infra.

jay: Workaround for CI in the meantime: update `ci/sast/pre-commit` workflow to run a mock keystore for unit tests by setting `USE_FAKE_KEYSTORE=true` in the job env. That avoids any production KMS calls until we have the SA flow. I'll open a tiny PR to the pipeline repo.

emma: Thanks — re-run queued jobs after Jordan's temporary binding and I'll verify.

oncall-jordan: Done — temporary binding added at 2026-03-23T14:08Z, expires in 1 hour. Re-run triggered.

emma: CI passed on rerun. Moving PR forward. I'll follow up with the migration ticket and link the audit events. :thumbsup:

maria: Great — next steps: (1) infra to create `ci-test-sa` + policy, (2) devs to adopt `USE_FAKE_KEYSTORE` for unit-level tests, (3) security to verify audit trail and close loop. I'll assign owners in the ticket.

emma: Sounds good — thanks everyone.
